CERTIFICATE OF REGISTRATION

Information Security Management System

This is to certify that the organisation has been assessed and registered
against the requirements of ISO/IEC 27001:2022.

Scope: Design, development, and operation of cloud-based software services,
including the associated information security management controls in Annex A.

Certificate Number: IS-7781024
Original Certification Date: March 15, 2025
This certificate is valid until March 14, 2028, subject to continued
surveillance audits.
